chains.title: FOXA1 binds the alt A allele more strongly at a TOX3 enhancer and increases TOX3 in breast cancer cells

links.claim: FOXA1 is the candidate TF because it has MCF-7 ChIP-seq peaks containing this base (E05) and is highly expressed in MCF7 (E05); E04 lists many co-bound TFs, so FOXA1 is selected as a strongly expressed breast-lineage factor with occupancy, not because an allelic assay exists. The alt A allele is predicted to bind FOXA1 more strongly, but no QBiC-SELEX model or allele-specific ChIP/reporter/MPRA for this exact base is supplied (E19), so ref/alt direction is only a motif-based hypothesis.
The variant lies in an Ensembl-annotated enhancer (ENSR16_9QTBS) and in dense MCF-7 TF-bound chromatin near a dELS, but no cCRE directly overlaps the base and the nearest dELS is 38 bp away.

TOX3 is the nearest protein-coding gene at 17.6 kb and is a breast cancer-associated locus (E21), but the exact SNP has no significant GTEx v8 eQTL in the supplied data (E17, E20), and no contact or perturbation evidence directly links this base to TOX3.
MCF-7 is the relevant breast cancer cell context because FOXA1 is bound over the variant in MCF-7 and is highly expressed there (E05), with matching active MCF-7 TF ChIP context at the element (E04).

Breast cancer is the phenotype at the TOX3 locus: TOX3 has Open Targets breast cancer evidence (E21) and literature support (E18a, E18b), but the exact variant has no GWAS Catalog or Open Targets record in the supplied evidence (E15, E16), so this is locus-level rather than exact-variant phenotype evidence.

predictions: Allele-specific FOXA1 ChIP/CUT&RUN or reporter/MPRA at the exact base will show stronger FOXA1 occupancy/activity on alt A than ref G.
Base editing ref G to alt A in MCF-7 or isogenic breast cancer cells will increase TOX3 expression or enhancer activity.
The alt A allele will track with increased TOX3 expression in breast tissue or breast cancer models if this element is active there.
falsified_if: Allele-specific FOXA1 ChIP/CUT&RUN or reporter/MPRA shows no difference between ref G and alt A, or shows ref G binds FOXA1 more strongly.
Base editing this exact base in an isogenic system does not change TOX3 expression or enhancer activity.
Fine-mapping or allele-specific assays show the disease signal tracks with a different linked variant independently of FOXA1 binding.

SPDEF occupancy over the variant in MCF-7 is supported by E07 and E04, and SPDEF is expressed. However, no QBiC-SELEX or allele-specific assay supports the ref G > alt A direction. SPDEF is also one of many co-bound TFs, and the allelic direction is motif-inferred.
